name: Plane for Orca
description: Your open Plane work items in Orca's sidebar: see what is assigned to you, read an item, and start a coding agent on it in a new workspace. Plane Cloud or self-hosted (API v2). Not affiliated with Plane.

cover.alt: The Plane panel in Orca lists your work items; Start on WEB-12 opens a workspace with Claude Code. Unofficial, not made or endorsed by Plane.

settings.title: Start prompt template
settings.description: Instructions for the agent's first prompt on Start. Placeholders: {key} (item key), {url} (item link), {ticket} (the fenced ticket block). Without {ticket} the block is added at the end; without {key} or {url} a line naming both comes first. Put {key} in your PR title rule, such as: Open a PR titled with {key}. Empty: the built-in prompt.

commands.title: Plane: go to an agent that waits for you
